# iosxe_wireless_ap_filter (Data Source)

This data source can read the Wireless AP Filter configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "iosxe_wireless_ap_filter" "example" {
  name = "S3-AF-TEST"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) filter name

### Optional

- `device` (String) A device name from the provider configuration.

### Read-Only

- `ap_name_regex` (String) regular expression string
- `filter_type` (String) AP filter type
- `id` (String) The path of the retrieved object.
- `tag_policy` (String) policy tag
- `tag_rf` (String) rf tag
- `tag_site` (String) site tag
